propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time when own_material changes are detected, causing billing waste.

Pass-1 checkpoints keyed by material fingerprint become unreusable after an edit, and the cancel predicate must be scoped to own material only to avoid reintroducing false cancellations on unrelated writes.
The cancel probe must be an out-of-band token checked before recovery paths to prevent a step failure from being recovered into a findings verdict that would flow to signing and sidecar emission.
The cancel mechanism probes for own_material changes at two between-pass seams (after finders, after decide) using a lightweight single-ticket read without store-wide reduction or sync locks.
A cancelled review returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale, skipping floors, signing, and sidecar emission, with CLI exit code 2.
Unrelated ticket writes or related_material drift do not trigger cancellation; only own_material changes cause mid-run cancellation, and no in-flight runner calls are interrupted.
